reason: The diff removes the hyphen from the escape operator class. Under 'u' flag, '\-' is an invalid identity escape (only SyntaxCharacter and '/'), so leaving it in caused new RegExp(..., 'u') to throw. Removing the hyphen keeps ordinary literal matching intact because an unescaped '-' outside a character class is a literal hyphen, and non-string rejection is untouched. The exact acceptance command passes 3/3, exercising ordinary matching, hyphen embedding in Unicode regex, and non-string rejection. This satisfies the stated ask.
